item.title: Navigating POPIA Compliance for South African SMEs
item.description: South Africa’s Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) safeguards personal data, requiring SMEs to process customer, employee, and supplier information responsibly. Compliance protects against fines up to R10 million or 10 years’ imprisonment while building customer trust. smesouthafrica
